integrity: General identities, geometric-product inequality, equality classification and lattice local-CLT asymptotic have analytic proofs. Finite exact tests are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Even \(n\ge4\), real coefficients, fair \((n-1)\)-wise independent signs, and degree exactly \(n\); the exact exponent, relative normalization and saddlepoint asymptotic are essential. Primary manuscript Gao--Qian full text inaccessible; novelty qualified.
title: Sharp relative moment sensitivity at the first detectable independence order
